title: ESM information request initiated by the network

entities.name: ESM information request procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to request ESM information from the UE. The network sends ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message, starts timer T3489, and enters PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.

entities.name: ESM INFORMATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to request ESM information. Contains PTI from associated PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST and EPS bearer identity set to 'no EPS bearer identity assigned'.

entities.name: ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network in response to ESM INFORMATION REQUEST. Contains protocol configuration options, APN if required, and PTI from request message.

entities.name: T3489
entities.description: Timer started by network when sending ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message and stopped upon receipt of ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State entered by network after sending ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by network after receiving ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: Security context setup
entities.description: Condition requiring that security context has been established before ESM INFORMATION REQUEST can be sent.

entities.name: ESM information transfer flag set
entities.description: Condition requiring that ESM information transfer flag has been set in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity included in ESM INFORMATION REQUEST and ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE messages.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: EPS bearer identity set to 'no EPS bearer identity assigned' in both ESM INFORMATION REQUEST and ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE messages.

relations.description: ESM information request procedure involves sending ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message.
Procedure starts timer T3489 when sending ESM INFORMATION REQUEST.
Procedure requires network to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message sending is guarded by security context setup condition.
ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message sending is guarded by ESM information transfer flag condition.
ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message contains Procedure Transaction Identity IE.
ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE set to 'no EPS bearer identity assigned'.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message contains Procedure Transaction Identity IE from request.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message contains EPS bearer identity IE set to 'no EPS bearer identity assigned'.
Receipt of ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message stops timer T3489.
Receipt of ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message establishes PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
